attribution.description: Attribution / credit for the dataset. Stored on the source; map libraries read it from the source (OpenLayers) or source options (MapLibre).

oneOf.title: IGeoJSONSourceV2Path
oneOf.description: Workspace or relative file path. Must not be an http(s) URL.

path.description: Local or workspace-relative path to a GeoJSON file.

oneOf.title: IGeoJSONSourceV2Url
oneOf.description: Remote GeoJSON fetched over HTTP(S). MapLibre/Deck can take this URL as source/layer data directly; OpenLayers resolves it then parses.

url.description: http(s) URL of a GeoJSON resource.

httpHeaders.description: HTTP headers sent with the request (e.g. Authorization). Key/value string map.
